verdict.rationale: Otter's own enterprise docs offer admin audit trails and activity logs, which give some admin visibility into account activity, and Channels provide a shared team space. Nothing documents private-by-default notes or granular link, folder or workspace permission controls, and multiple community reports say conversations are shared with all meeting attendees by default. missing for 10: private-by-default note settings, granular link/folder/workspace permission controls, admin visibility specifically into what has been shared, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, sharing is controlled — private-by-default notes, granular link/folder/workspace permissions, and admin visibility into what's shared

citations.quote: Maintain visibility into account activity with audit trails and logging, supporting your security, compliance, and regulatory reporting needs.
Enhanced admin features: activity logs, usage analytics, and more
Meetings grouped by team, project, or topic so everyone can find recordings and collaborate in one shared space.
